programme.title: Love Break Up Zindagi
programme.desc: A couple and many of their friends experience changes and challenges in their respective lives after attending a wedding.

programme.title: Comedy Station - Bittu Bak Bak
programme.desc: Series of short, comedic vignettes where an unlucky Bhojpuri producer Champaklal and his secretary Suzie hilariously navigate chaotic, low-budget filmmaking, trying to outsmart each other.

programme.title: Rafoo Chakkar
programme.desc: Two friends witness a murder by three criminals. They flee the scene, with the criminals in hot pursuit. What one of the criminals does not know is that he is out to kill his own son.

programme.title: Kabhi Na Kabhi
programme.desc: Jaggu gets arrested after a witness informs the police about his crimes. Meanwhile, Raja is hired in his place. Once out, Jaggu kills the witness, who happens to be Raja's father.

programme.title: Haathkadi
programme.desc: An inspector hires four juveniles to kidnap a politician as he wants to usurp the minister's property. The juveniles have other plans for the politician, who was responsible for them going to jail

programme.title: Tum Mere Ho
programme.desc: Snake charmer Shiva falls in love with Paro, whose father is against the relationship. But when Shiva saves Paro's life from a deadly snake, he gains her father's trust.

programme.title: Professor Ki Padosan
programme.desc: Vidyadhar consumes a potion to become invisible in order to escape his wife Shobha's ire when she learns of his affair with Menka.

programme.desc: A villager pretends to be disabled in order to be near an NRI.

programme.title: Pyare Mohan

programme.title: Hum Aapke Dil Mein Rehte Hain
programme.desc: Not knowing what consequences she would face, a woman signs a 1-year marriage contract with a business tycoon to end her family's poverty.

programme.title: Dor
programme.desc: Zeenat's husband accidentally kills a man in Saudi Arabia and the only way to save him from death is to obtain forgiveness from the widow of the deceased.

programme.title: Patthar Ke Sanam
programme.desc: Rajesh works for Meena's father. Meena and her friend Taruna decide to play a prank on him. Both women pretend to fall in love with him, but he finds out, resulting in acrimony.
